Your friends and family will all tell you the app is nice. They are being polite and it tells you nothing.

Modraly is in TestFlight review right now and I have lost the ability to judge it myself. I have been in the tunnel so long that I have no idea what a stranger feels in the first thirty seconds of opening it, whether the paid features are worth paying for, or whether the price I picked reflects anything real.

I know the answer. Ship it, and talk to people. That has not made the doubt any
